breakdown.description: The prompt doubles the extreme-fiber distance by taking c = h instead of c = h/2 for a rectangular section bent about its centroidal axis.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses c = h/2, as evidenced by the derived formula h ≥ √(6 M_max / (b σ_allow)), which comes directly from σ = M·(h/2)/(bh³/12). The erroneous instruction to use c = h was ignored, and the result (h ≈ 70.7 mm, rounded to 71 mm) aligns with the correct formulation from the ground truth prompt.
